purpose: Test fail-closed behavior when fresh terminal evidence cannot be assigned to any predeclared qualification stratum, so a fixed taxonomy cannot silently misclassify novel failure regimes as normal evidence.
mechanism_placeholder: open-set reject/abstain with later-generation taxonomy expansion
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local switch qualification trace only; unknown rejection is a safety mechanism, not a claim that the unknown can always be correctly classified later.
classification_rule: An evidence artifact must satisfy exactly one predeclared stratum predicate for the current taxonomy generation. Zero matches => UNCLASSIFIED; multiple matches => AMBIGUOUS. Neither state can satisfy promotion coverage or award credit.
expansion_rule: An UNCLASSIFIED/AMBIGUOUS artifact may trigger a separately sealed taxonomy-classification decision, but any new stratum becomes eligible only in the next taxonomy/authority generation. The artifact that caused the expansion cannot retroactively validate the generation in which it was first observed.

fixed_trace.event: U1 fresh same-scope terminal artifact matches zero known strata
fixed_trace.expected: U1=UNCLASSIFIED; preserve immutable anomaly; block promotion

fixed_trace.event: U1 re-labeled ad hoc as S_NORMAL without separate sealed taxonomy decision
U2 matches both S_BOUNDARY and S_RECOVERY
separate terminal taxonomy decision defines S_NOVEL for U1-like evidence
fixed_trace.expected: taxonomy generation advances; S_NOVEL active only for next generation

fixed_trace.event: reuse original U1 to satisfy S_NOVEL coverage in the new generation
fixed_trace.expected: reject as previously consumed/old-generation evidence; require fresh U3

fixed_trace.event: fresh U3 same-scope terminal PASS matches S_NOVEL under new generation
fixed_trace.expected: may satisfy S_NOVEL only after durable readback; other required strata still needed

fixed_trace.event: late completion using old taxonomy generation

fixed_trace.control: no safe taxonomy classification for U1/U2
fixed_trace.expected: remain unresolved with frontier_nonempty=true and zero new credit

guards.G1: known strata and exact-one-match rule are frozen before public source audit
guards.G2: zero-match evidence becomes UNCLASSIFIED and cannot authorize promotion/credit
guards.G3: multi-match evidence becomes AMBIGUOUS and cannot authorize promotion/credit
guards.G4: ad hoc same-generation relabeling is forbidden
guards.G5: taxonomy expansion requires a separately sealed terminal classification decision
guards.G6: new strata activate only in a later taxonomy/authority generation
guards.G7: the anomaly that caused expansion cannot retroactively validate the new stratum
guards.G8: fresh new-generation terminal evidence is required for coverage of a newly added stratum
guards.G9: old taxonomy/authority generation completions are stale
guards.G10: absence of a safe classification leaves the controller unresolved with nonempty frontier
guards.G11: terminal leaf artifact must be independently read back before any role-local credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 hold after public-source mechanism binding; no post-source taxonomy or rubric edits.
credit_rule: Precommit earns zero credit; at most one role-local credit after terminal readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Select another non-conflicting switching/recovery failure mode; preserve the limitation that reject/abstain does not itself solve how to classify novel regimes.
